context: The source archive validator detected a duplicate Circle Arc source ID that already existed in an earlier source shard.
decision: Before appending a source, compare its canonical id against every currently referenced source shard, not only the latest chunks.
Reuse an existing canonical source record when it already supports the claim; do not create a second record for the same source ID.
If a duplicate is discovered, preserve the duplicate-containing shard unreferenced and append a corrected shard that retains the same chunk index/count with the duplicate record removed.
Keep the snapshot's source reference pointing to the existing canonical record and rerun exact-head validation.
invariants: Source IDs are globally unique across referenced shards.
All prior records and malformed/duplicate shards remain preserved.
No market feature admitted and forecast remains NOT_ISSUED.
No main-branch write, merge, force-push or workflow dispatch.
